snippet.title: MINECRAFT STORY MODE: The Remake - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
When one story ends, another one begins. 

The title of the upcoming Minecraft Story Mode remake is "Block By Block."

Coming to YouTube soon.

Co-Animated by RawData (https://sites.google.com/view/rawdata-portfolio/)

Join the official 'Block By Block' Discord:
https://discord.gg/C5cvC8yNJB

Follow us on Social for more info:
https://x.com/BlockByBlockYT
https://blockbyblockseries.tumblr.com/

Music By:
https://www.youtube.com/@UCemfUpErlIGq5_ZsDVlEorg
https://www.youtube.com/Kraedt  
https://www.youtube.com/@UC5Izr-1dWOO1BocgjN3cdkw 


Built In Co-operation With:
https://www.youtube.com/@UCDqw69rCTJubJb7zHg81fJg 
(https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/mcsm-rebuilt-in-minecraft/)

Block By Block is an minecraft-animated series adaption of Telltale's Minecraft Story Mode video game. It'll be taking the narrative of the point-and-click adventure game, and putting it into a new medium in the form of an action-adventure, fantasy animation series! Characters, plotlines, and worlds will be reimagined into a new story that's aiming to be fresh, unique, and different to the original game in order to create a new experience for lifelong fans and newcomers alike to enjoy.

—

As stated in Minecraft’s End User License Agreement (EULA), allowance is made for fan projects of this kind as long as they follow their specific guidelines; this includes not using their name (Minecraft) as the main title and not hiding our project behind a paywall. In respect of these guidelines, we will not use the name “Minecraft: Story Mode” when promoting this series but instead: “Block by Block: The Amulet” and “Block by Block: The Amulet” will ALWAYS be free to watch on the platform YouTube for everyone’s enjoyment. Any content of this series locked behind a paywall has not been approved by Wazzy (Project Director and Lead Animator).

“Block by Block: The Amulet” is a transformative work and reimagining of the game “Minecraft: Story Mode” developed by Telltale Games. This project is not affiliated, endorsed by, or acknowledged by Mojang, Microsoft, or Telltale Games. All non-original characters, concepts and worlds are owned by Mojang, Microsoft, and any other respective property owners. Microsoft or Mojang is free to contact wazzysolo.business@gmail.com if we are found not properly following their EULA.

—

#mcsm #blockbyblock #indie #animation #fanmade #minecraft #minecraftanimation #minecraftstorymode #mcsm_remake
